name: @dsh-external/dotdsh-copilot-auth
description: dotdsh copilot-auth: the human-initiated GitHub Copilot sign-in dsh does not ship — a /copilot-login|status|logout command set and a dotdsh-copilot-auth CLI that store the llm-pi-ai/github-copilot grant through the harness credential seam, so the stock llm-pi-ai route can serve the subscription

scripts.test: pnpm build && node test/verify-grant.mjs && node test/verify-redact.mjs && node test/verify-login.mjs && node test/verify-commands.mjs && node test/verify-cli.mjs
